subject: Renewal discussion: ArchStream renewal, uplift, and transitional pricing
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@archstream.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal discussion: ArchStream renewal, uplift, and transitional pricing

Hi Alex —

It was great catching up on Tuesday. Per our conversation I pulled together a short plan to make the renewal straightforward while supporting ArchStream's expected uplift later this year. High level:

- Offer a 12-month renewal with a staged commit increase (30% in Q1, additional 20% in Q3)
- Provide a transitional price-hold for the first 6 months (same unit rates as current) and a stepped price for months 7–12 tied to commit bands
- Provide a one-time onboarding/uptake credit of $50k to offset migration spikes (applied as invoice credit)

I attached a draft playbook (renewal_playbook_raf.xlsx) with the commit bands and an example amortization of credits. Can you confirm ArchStream's expected run-rate for Q1 and whether Procurement will require PO timing by end of November?

Next steps I propose: a 30-minute pricing alignment with your procurement and finance this week, then we send a clean amendment + redline.

Thanks — happy to jump on a call.

— Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@archstream.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@archstream.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion: ArchStream renewal, uplift, and transitional pricing

Rafael —

Thanks for the summary and the playbook. A few clarifications from our side:

- We are planning to increase consumption ~40% starting Jan 1 when we launch the new recommendation model. That aligns roughly with your Q1 uplift.
- Procurement needs a PO by 2026-11-15 for budget planning.
- The security team will run a light review; they asked that any new pricing/credits be called out in the amendment so audit reports show the credits applied.

If you can give us a firm invoice schedule and confirm the credit treatment (one-time invoice credit vs refundable credit), we can get internal approvals faster. Happy to do a 30-min sync Thursday morning PST.

Best,
Alex
Alex Wu
Head of Data Platforms, ArchStream
alex.wu@archstream.com

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal discussion: ArchStream renewal, uplift, and transitional pricing

Team —

Forwarding Alex's reply. Key asks: PO by 2026-11-15, treatment of $50k uptake credit (must show on amendment) and confirmation of invoice schedule. ArchStream is expecting ~40% Jan uplift and wants price-hold for first 6 months.

Proposed internal offer (need quick thumbs):
- 12-month term starting 2027-01-01
- Committed spend: 100% current baseline for months 1–3, +30% months 4–6, +40% months 7–12 (we can present both % and token bands)
- Price: current unit rates for months 1–6, step increase of +8% months 7–12 but capped at current list for larger commits
- One-time uptake credit $50k applied as invoice credit at first invoice after effective date; show as line item and footnote in amendment
- Invoice schedule: quarterly in arrears (Q1 invoice includes applied credit line)

Ben — can you run numbers quickly on margin impact and propose an alternate discount if they push for a longer price-hold (9 months)?
Karthik — we may need your sign-off on SLA carveouts if they request burst capacity guarantees.
Marissa — please prepare a clean amendment template and include a line showing the credit and audit language Alex requested.

Attachments: renewal_playbook_raf.xlsx (draft)

— Rafael

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T10:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal discussion: ArchStream renewal, uplift, and transitional pricing

Rafael / team —

Quick calc attached (redline_v1.pdf stubbed) — summary:
- With the proposed staged commit, blended realized price is flat versus current ARR for year 1 after the $50k credit. Margin impact is ~3.2% on FY27 run-rate (acceptable).
- If ArchStream asks for a 9-month price-hold we can offer it but convert the $50k uptake credit to a $30k credit + 2% off the blended rate for Q4 (to preserve margin).
- If procurement needs PO by 11/15 we should send the clean amendment by 11/03 to allow legal/GC review and any redlines.

Recommendation: present the 6-month price-hold as primary; present the 9-month variant as an explicit alternative tied to the blended discount swap above. Call out credit as "invoice credit — non-refundable — applied to first invoice after effective date" to satisfy audit.

I'll queue finance ops for a fast review and share final numbers by EOD tomorrow.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@archstream.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@archstream.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-22T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal amendment (clean) and options for ArchStream — next steps

Alex —

Thanks again for the call. Attached are two items: 1) a clean amendment that reflects the staged commit and the invoice credit treatment, and 2) a short options sheet showing the 6-month price-hold (preferred) and the 9-month alternative (credit + blended discount). Files: redline_v1.pdf (summary of numbers) and renewal_playbook_raf.xlsx.

Key points front-and-center for Procurement:
- PO timing: please aim for PO by 2026-11-15 so we can execute and lock the effective date to 2027-01-01
- Credit treatment: $50k invoice credit, non-refundable, applied to first invoice after effective date, will be visible on the amendment and on audit logs
- Invoice cadence: quarterly in arrears; first invoice will include credit line and then normal billing

If Procurement is ready we can route to Legal for a 72-hour review once we receive the PO. Rafael and Ben will be your points of contact for the amendment.

Next actions for ArchStream: send PO to procurement@redwood.com and provide any redline feedback on the attached amendment by 2026-11-03.

Thanks — look forward to closing this out.

— Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
Attachment stubs: redline_v1.pdf (application/pdf), renewal_playbook_raf.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
